Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000067

to the Committee on Appropriations as we begin deliberations on its proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000068

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000069

reflecting the government's continuing commitment to our national security,

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000070

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000071

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000072

of which $50 billion is allocated for the revised AFP modernization program

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000073

to support the acquisition and the upgrading of equipment and systems necessary

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000074

to keep our armed forces capable and responsive to the security challenges of our time.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000076

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000077

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000078

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000079

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000080

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000081

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000082

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000083

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000084

our partnerships with like-minded nations have deepened,

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000085

and our forces have carried the weight professionally and well.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000086

Our soldiers continue to bear internal security,

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000087

and in every community struck by earthquake, by flood, by storm,

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000088

it is the men in uniform that arrive first.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000089

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000090

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000091

that struck our communities in the 2nd District of Sultan Kudarat,

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000092

that is what this budget is for.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000093

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000094

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000095

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000096

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000098

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000099

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000100

Congress and this representation will support a modernization program carried to completion

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000101

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000104

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000105

that should be at the forefront of national policy discussions.

Source

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000107

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000108

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

asr-000110

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing

So it will not meet the needs of a future armed force. So unless you put in the law provision for equity or research and development, there will be no right-thinking producer of technology that will allow you to benefit on the upside when you do not share the risk of the downside. That is a simple value proposition, Your Honor. Because the most important thing is not the production, even though 100% production is done outside. It's the intellectual property rights that are important, that you have equal rights to the IPR. That is the key and the cornerstone. If you cannot acquire the intellectual property rights, then you have no rights at all, even though you are co-producing. There will be no technology transfer.
